gap: Bulky objects like planters defaulted to 0.20mm layer height without offering 0.28mm draft speed option, causing unnecessarily long print times when fine precision is not critical.
rule: For bulky structural designs (planters, trays, bins), proactively clarify layer height preference (0.20mm Standard vs 0.28mm Extra Draft) during intake; ensure vertical Z-steps and sacrificial bridges are compatible with 0.28mm, and document draft speed print estimates.

gap: Bambu Studio 2.6 rejected sparse_infill_pattern=rectilinear with a warning popup, showed a Customized Preset G-code security popup when machine include gcode templates were omitted, renamed dropdown presets to (filename), and rejected dangling 3D/_rels/ entries on Stage-2 CLI round-trips.
rule: Always use gyroid for sparse_infill_pattern; recursively resolve both inherits and include JSON templates in _flatten_bambu_json() before CLI 3MF generation with native Bambu Lab P2S 0.4 nozzle (Textured PEI Plate), Bambu PLA Basic @BBL P2S, and installed user fine-print presets (e.g. 0.16mm Precision @BBL P2S - Ujoy PLA+) so different_settings_to_system[1..2] stay empty; and strip 3D/_rels/ alongside 3D/Objects/ before Stage-2 CLI round-trips.

gap: Hopper slopes had vertical cut-off steps on Front and Left walls, lacked Back slope coverage around the circular slider housing guide contour, and BuildSketch Polygon ruled lofts could twist vertex order.
rule: Preserve an unbroken circular slider guide contour (R_guide = R_blade + 0.85 mm clearance) around rotary quarter-circle shutters, sweep Front, Left, and Back slopes continuously down to R_guide with zero cut-off cliffs, keep blind shutter pockets beneath the slope floor (-2 deg ceiling pitch + 4.5 deg wall draft for 0.0 g internal support at 46 deg tilt), verify 0.000000 mm3 collision across multi-angle rotation and 3D insertion paths, and build multi-vertex lofts directly from explicit Face(Wire.make_polygon(...)) wires.
